themes_detail.label: Wildlife Invasion in Parks
themes_detail.summary: Animal-in-park complaints spiked to 5 reports THIS WEEK versus 0.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 900% spike (z-score: 6.36)—suggesting a sudden wildlife management crisis in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights parks that warrants immediate investigation into root causes and resident safety.
evidence: 5 animal-in-park complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (900% spike)
Z-score of 6.36 indicates statistically significant deviation
No prior Reddit discussions or local news coverage of animal issues in district
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Dept on what animals are appearing, where, and whether food sources/habitat changes are driving the surge
Talk to residents in parks near complaints—Owl's Head Park, Shore Road Park—about encounters and safety concerns

themes_detail.label: Illegal Fireworks Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal fireworks complaints peaked at 21 reports two weeks ago versus 0.9 weekly average (2,300% spike, z-score: 19.11)—the highest severity statistical anomaly in the dataset—indicating either an organized event, illegal distribution network, or seasonal pattern that poses public safety and quality-of-life risks.
evidence: 21 fireworks complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.9 weekly average (2,300% increase)
Highest z-score in entire dataset (19.11) indicates exceptional statistical significance
No follow-up complaints noted in most recent week—spike appears to have subsided but warrants explanation
reporting_angles: NYPD and Fire Dept: Were there coordinated enforcement sweeps? Any arrests or seizures of illegal fireworks inventory?
Community Board and elected officials: Did residents report this issue? What enforcement response occurred?

themes_detail.label: Noise Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints (residential and general) surged to 33 reports last week versus 11.1 weekly average (197% increase, z-score: 5.72), driven by unidentified sources and indicating a deteriorating acoustic environment affecting quality of life across the district.
evidence: 33 noise complaints last week vs. 11.1 weekly average (197% increase)
Z-score of 5.72 indicates high statistical significance
Noise ranks as top 5 complaint category overall (701 complaints over 90 days), suggesting chronic baseline with acute recent worsening
reporting_angles: Map the 33 complaints by location and time of day—is there a geographic cluster or temporal pattern (construction hours, nightlife, events)?
Residents and CB: Have there been new bars, venues, or construction projects licensed or filed in the past month that correlate?

themes_detail.label: Electrical Infrastructure Failures
themes_detail.summary: Electric-related complaints jumped to 14 reports last week versus 4.2 weekly average (229% increase, z-score: 5.95), potentially indicating aging grid stress, storm damage, or power quality issues affecting households and businesses.
evidence: 14 electric complaints last week vs. 4.2 weekly average (229% spike)
Z-score of 5.95 indicates statistically significant anomaly
No recent mentions in local news or Reddit; suggests issue may be under-reported in mainstream outlets
reporting_angles: Con Edison: Were there weather events, equipment failures, or maintenance work that explains the spike?
Residents affected by outages or brownouts: Collect stories on duration, impact on heating/cooling, refrigeration

themes_detail.label: Street Sign Maintenance Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Missing street sign complaints jumped to 5 reports two weeks ago versus 0.8 weekly average (567% spike, z-score: 6.43), suggesting inadequate city maintenance or possible vandalism that impairs navigation and pedestrian safety.
evidence: 5 missing street sign complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average (567% increase)
Z-score of 6.43 indicates statistically significant spike
Street Condition and Traffic Signal Condition complaints also elevated (422 and 350 total over 90 days), suggesting broader street infrastructure degradation
reporting_angles: DOT: What's the replacement timeline? Are signs missing due to weather damage, vandalism, or deferred maintenance?
Walk affected blocks to verify and photograph missing signs; note which intersections lack directional markers
